name: Neverwinter Nights 2: Enhanced Edition

eax.problem: The 2025 Enhanced Edition (Aspyr) is a from-scratch engine rewrite — it never had DirectSound3D EAX to begin with.

notes: If you also own the classic build, it's a separate GOG product the scanner detects on its own — see the 'Neverwinter Nights 2' entry (gog_id 1207659162), which has real DirectSound3D EAX.
